title: Telemetry
summary: What the harness records about its own steps: a local metadata-only log, how long it is kept and whether it is exported.

options.label: A local metadata log, one JSON line per step
options.tradeoff: Works on every host and feeds routing calibration; token and cost fields are partial where a host hook lacks them.

options.label: The host's own OpenTelemetry export only
options.tradeoff: Richest data; exists on three hosts, needs a collector and a DLP review of what the host exports.

options.label: No recording
options.tradeoff: Nothing to store or review; routing cannot be calibrated and cost stays invisible.

questions.prompt: How many days is the metadata log kept?
Is telemetry exported off the machine?

options.label: No export
options.tradeoff: No new data-handling surface; no team-wide view until the observability pack.

options.label: Export to an OTLP endpoint
options.tradeoff: Team visibility early; needs a collector and a DLP review of the endpoint.

questions.prompt: What is the OTLP endpoint URL?

decisions.title: Each routed step is recorded as one metadata JSON line in the local state directory
decisions.body:
## Decision

Record one JSON line of metadata per step in the gitignored state directory (`telemetry.jsonl`): model, effort, token counts by cache state, cost, task class, outcome, escalations and timestamps, never prompt or file content (pack {{pack.id}}@{{pack.version}}).

## Why

Routing calibration (decision 0017) needs outcomes on every host, and keeping data local avoids a new data-handling surface (decision 0018).

decisions.title: Steps are recorded only through the host's own OpenTelemetry export
decisions.body:
## Decision

Do not keep a go-getter log; rely on each host's OpenTelemetry export where it has one (pack {{pack.id}}@{{pack.version}}).

## Why

Hosts that export OpenTelemetry give the richest data without a second recorder; hosts without it are not observed.

decisions.title: Steps are not recorded
decisions.body:
## Decision

Record nothing about agent steps (pack {{pack.id}}@{{pack.version}}).

## Why

Nothing recorded means no new data-handling surface; routing then runs on defaults without calibration (decision 0017).

decisions.title: The metadata log keeps {{answer.retention}} days
decisions.body:
## Decision

Keep log lines for {{answer.retention}} days; every write prunes older lines (pack {{pack.id}}@{{pack.version}}).

## Why

Calibration needs recent data only, and old metadata is a liability without a use.

decisions.title: Telemetry is not exported
decisions.body:
## Decision

Telemetry stays on the machine (pack {{pack.id}}@{{pack.version}}).

## Why

Team export arrives with the v0.2 observability pack; until then local data adds no new data-handling surface (decision 0018).

decisions.title: Telemetry is exported to an OTLP endpoint
decisions.body:
## Decision

Export telemetry to the OTLP endpoint named in the endpoint decision (pack {{pack.id}}@{{pack.version}}).

## Why

Team visibility needs one place to read the data.

decisions.title: The OTLP endpoint is {{answer.otlp-endpoint}}
decisions.body:
## Decision

Export to {{answer.otlp-endpoint}} (pack {{pack.id}}@{{pack.version}}).

## Why

An explicit endpoint keeps the export destination reviewable.
